title: H369 — ReCAP: Regime-Adaptive Continual Learning for ETF Rotation (arXiv:2606.00143)
description: Apply the ReCAP (Regime-aware Continual Adaptive Portfolio management) framework from arXiv:2606.00143 to the production ETF rotation portfolio (H026/H041a/H045 blend). Instead of refitting strategy weights on a fixed rolling window each month, ReCAP maintains separate strategy modules per regime and transfers knowledge across regime transitions — avoiding the 'catastrophic forgetting' that causes rolling-window approaches to discard crisis-era learning just before the next crisis. The implementation: (1) detect regime with the H249 engine (SPY 200MA × VIX + rate-hike modifier); (2) maintain per-regime weight estimates for the 3-strategy blend; (3) when regime transitions, transfer 50% of prior regime's estimates to the new regime's module rather than starting fresh.
rationale: H249 CONFIRMED regime-conditional portfolio weights (OOS Sharpe +0.282 improvement, MaxDD −4.7pp). But H249 uses static per-regime weights estimated from IS data — it does not update these weights as OOS data accumulates. ReCAP addresses this: the regime modules are continually updated, but in a structured way that prevents knowledge loss. The paper reports ~+15% Sharpe and −30% MaxDD vs rolling-window retraining on equity portfolios. For our use case, this would allow the strategy blend to gradually adapt to the 2023-2026 OOS environment without abandoning the regime-conditional structure that produced H249's gains. The key innovation: regime-specific elastic weight consolidation (EWC) prevents catastrophic forgetting of crisis-regime performance when updating on bull-market data.
gate: OOS Sharpe > 4.158 (current production blend) AND MaxDD > -3.60% (better than current)
implementation_notes: Monthly rebalance. Regime detection: SPY > 200MA AND VIX < 20 = bull; SPY < 200MA OR VIX > 25 = bear; else neutral. Per-regime weight estimator: simple Sharpe-maximizing optimizer with EWC penalty (lambda=0.1 × Fisher information). On regime change: new_theta = 0.5 * old_regime_theta + 0.5 * prior_estimate. Compare vs: (a) static 40/30/30, (b) H249 static regime-conditional, (c) ReCAP. Full walk-forward: retrain monthly on expanding IS window with EWC.
notes: EWC is optional complexity — start with the simpler knowledge transfer (50/50 blending on regime change) and only add EWC if the simple version shows promise. The core insight is regime-memory, not the specific EWC method.
note_renumbered: Renumbered from H364 — H364 was already confirmed as a different hypothesis
